Seeding idempotent: 'seeded' settings flag checked before a single transaction (server.js:93-127). Fixed clock read from seed (server.js:32), matching integration.md:7. Runtime deps express 5.1.0 / better-sqlite3 12.4.1 are installed globally in both environment/Dockerfile and tests/Dockerfile and resolved via NODE_PATH, which test.sh passes in its env -i launch; no solve-time install or network fetch is needed (public network would make that only a NOTE anyway). The Internal sheet's 'no network / no run-time install' wording is superseded by the client sheet and the skill delivery profile (public network); the golden satisfies even the stricter reading.
